description: Place a perp order on HyperLiquid without TP/SL, via /hl/create_order: isMarket=true (default) is a market order, isMarket=false a limit order resting at `price` (with reduceOnly=true, a limit close). A non-reduce-only limit at or through the mark price is refused. Pass leverage (omitted = the market's maximum). To close at market use close_perp_position.

accountRef.description: Connected account from gdex_connect. Supplies session key, wallet address, API key and session data so no secret is passed in chat

apiKey.description: GDEX API key for AES encryption

isLong.description: True for long, false for short

isMarket.description: True for market, false for limit

leverage.description: Leverage, 1 up to the market's maximum; omitted = the market's MAXIMUM. For reduceOnly pass the position's current leverage.

price.description: Limit price in USD; for a market order the mark reference ('0' fetches the mark)

name: place_perp_order
